_note: 2026-11-10: the 23 lich looks that reused a living piece's mesh with a lich texture, remade as their own pieces (user's choice). Concept = text + suffix[kind]; gpt-image-2-5-sunburst 1:1. Kinds: hip (fit round the hips), over (worn over the loincloth), band (women's chest wrap), torso, legs, cape, shoulder.

suffix.hip: Ghost-mannequin product shot: only this loincloth, floating as if worn on an invisible body's hips, centred, seen from the front and a little above, plain light grey background, soft even studio light, photoreal, highly detailed. lich_hide: A lich's plain burial loincloth: a hip wrap of undyed grave linen gone yellow-grey with age, a long front flap and a long back flap with frayed, torn hems, tied at the hips by a twisted sinew cord with two knucklebone toggles, faint brown grave stains.
lich_fine: A noble lich's loincloth: a hip cord of plaited black leather with a small tarnished pewter buckle shaped like a closed eye; long front and back flaps of finely woven charcoal-grey barrow wool, edged with a narrow band of tarnished silver thread and a row of tiny yellowed bone beads along the hem.
lich_royal: A royal lich's loincloth: a stiff belt of black-lacquered leather set with three cloudy pale moonstones; long front and back flaps of faded plum-purple silk embroidered with small silver crescent moons and dead stars, the hems weighted with drop-shaped pale glass beads, a little moth-eaten.
lich_skirt: A lich's strip skirt: a rope belt of grey hemp bound with linen, hung all round with many separate strips of stained burial wrappings, ash-grey and bone-white, of uneven lengths down to just above the knee, each strip ending in a small knotted bone bead, gaps between the strips.
lich_tunic: A lich's sleeveless burial tunic: a long shroud-like tunic of coarse ash-grey linen from the shoulders to mid-thigh, wide armholes, a plain round neck, tied at the waist by a black cord sash; the hem frayed and torn into points, faint black funerary sigils stitched down the front, dusty grave stains.
lich_band: A lich's chest wrap: a bandeau of undyed grave linen gone yellow-grey, wound twice round the bust, its frayed ends knotted at the centre front, a thin sinew cord with one knucklebone bead tied over the knot.
lich_band_fine: A noble lich's chest band: a bandeau of finely woven charcoal-grey barrow wool, edged top and bottom with narrow tarnished silver thread, a row of tiny yellowed bone beads along the upper edge, a small pewter closed-eye clasp at the centre front.
lich_band_royal: A royal lich's chest band: a bandeau of faded plum-purple silk embroidered with small silver crescent moons, a tarnished silver clasp shaped like an eclipsed moon at the centre front, short strings of pale glass drop beads hanging from the lower edge.
lich_war: A lich's war belt: a broad belt of blackened mail rings over cracked leather with a rusted iron buckle shaped like a horned skull, three small bird and rat skulls hanging on cords at the front, and a short drape of torn black cloth at each hip.
lich_armour: A lich's armoured skirt: a waist belt from which hang overlapping rows of corroded bronze lamellar scales laced with rotted black cord, in four separate panels (front, back and both sides) split apart so the legs can move, down to mid-thigh, green verdigris in the recesses.
lich_duke: A lich duke's short apron: a stiff front apron of black hide to mid-thigh on a plain dark leather belt, painted in bone-white with an eclipsed-moon disc and a border of small skulls, edged with a fringe of knucklebone beads, and a short plain back flap.
lich_king: A lich king's long aprons: a front and a back panel down to the knees of ash-grey woven linen with bone-white woven geometric burial patterns of stepped lozenges and zigzags, a fringe of tiny strung vertebrae at the hems, hung from a dark leather belt set with small black soul-gem shards.
lich_emperor: A lich emperor's regalia: long front and back aprons to below the knees of black-green tarnished gold brocade, richly embroidered, a wide gilded belt plaque set with three black soul gems, the hems finished with a fringe of gold beads alternating with finger bones, a short tasselled drape at each hip.
lich_camp_wrap: A lich's camp wrap: a length of coarse black blanket wool wrapped once round the hips and knotted at the left hip, the loose end hanging in a long heavy fold, frayed edges, a small iron ring and a bone tally stick tied into the knot.
lich_kid_charm: A young undead's charm cord: a thin plaited cord of grey wool worn round the hips, with a small carved bone doll charm, a tiny black leather pouch and three bone beads hanging at the front.
lich_trophy_1: A lich's first trophy cord: a plain thin braided black cord worn round the hips, with three small yellowed animal jawbones hanging at the front.
lich_trophy_2: A lich's trophy belt: a narrow braided black leather cord worn round the hips, hung all round with yellowed jawbones and rows of long animal fangs on short strings.
lich_trophy_3: A great lich's trophy belt: a narrow braided black leather cord worn round the hips, heavy with yellowed jawbones, long fangs and knucklebones, one small horned skull at the front and a few tattered black ribbons.
lich_leggings: A lich's leg wrappings: separate wrappings round each leg from the ankle to the top of the thigh, of narrow strips of rotted ash-grey burial linen wound spirally and overlapping, tied below each knee with a dark leather thong, a few loose fraying ends.
lich_mantle: A lich's shoulder mantle: a cape of moth-eaten black wool falling from the shoulders to the calves behind, a collar of patchy grey wolf fur, fastened at the chest by a carved bone clasp on a short chain, the hem tattered.
lich_fur_robe: A lich's fur robe: a heavy cape of matted, mangy dark grey-brown bear fur with bald patches, falling from the shoulders to the calves behind, its edges bound with cracked black leather, fastened across the chest by two bone toggles on a leather thong.
lich_arena_guard: A lich's arena shoulder guard: a pauldron of layered blackened iron lames riveted to cracked leather, the top plate shaped like a broad shoulder-blade bone, a short bone spike on top, held on by a leather strap.
